description: Turns gates into chromatic transposition: each jack adds its own number of semitones to a pitch, with the total added on one output and taken off the other

inputs.text: The pitch the semitones are added to and taken from
Adds the number of semitones marked on it, a full step at 10V and less in proportion below that
Nothing in the module reads this jack: the loop that adds the semitones stops one jack short

outputs.text: The pitch with every jack's semitones added
The pitch with every jack's semitones taken off

notes: the jacks are not read as gates but as levels: a jack at 5V adds half its semitone count, so a slow envelope here glides the transposition rather than stepping it
